exposure: Timing of elective cesarean section (37+0 - 38+6 weeks vs. >39+0 weeks)
cohort: The study included 829 cases of term cesarean sections in women with a history of prior cesarean, and their neonates.
finding: Neonates born via cesarean section after 39+0 weeks gestational age had higher 5-minute Apgar scores and higher birthweight compared to those born prior to 39 weeks.
mod_finding: Cesarean sections performed at >39+0 weeks were associated with better neonatal outcomes compared to those performed earlier.
